The life of a session

A teammate is durable; a session is one running instance of it. Drive this timeline from spawn to exit, then watch resume relaunch the same conversation.

02What the graph remembers

Exit ends the process, not the entity. The work_session record keeps its identity and lifecycle fields; a worktree session is associated to its lane by the real in_worktree edge.

03Three rules worth carrying

I

Checkpoint is a worktree act

session checkpoint commits the lane’s entire WIP and returns a ref. A clean tree succeeds with HEAD; it creates nothing new.

II

Transcript is not terminal paint

session transcript reads the agent’s native turns. It omits tool arguments and output; those are where file contents and secrets travel.

III

Resume is exact—or refused

tm8 resumes by the provider-native session id. It refuses when an agent tool has no resume-by-id contract, or when a Codex rollout cannot be located.

What changes on resumeThe conversation is restored exactly, while persona, project, tasks, model, and cwd are read again from the graph. The caller supplies only the session id.
